name.full: Sir John Winton "Earl of Minorites" Mansfield

notes: FABRICATED PEERAGE TITLE (deep-chain audit, 2026-07-03): 'Earl of Minorites' is not a real peerage title — 'Minorites' is the name for Franciscan friars (Order of Friars Minor), not a place or earldom, and no such creation exists in the Complete Peerage. Appears to be an invented noble father grafted onto the real Great Migration immigrant Robert Mansfield (I182620325010), likely borrowing the surname/prestige of the genuine Welsh Mansel family of Margam/Oxwich. Treat this individual and any connection to the Mansels as unsupported legend.
